userStories.title: Enumerate runtime placeholders and re-status fill-in templates (ARC-051 decisions 1-3, 5)
userStories.description: In src/assets/.arcane/governance/spell-authoring-standards.md add a delimited, machine-readable list of runtime-resolved `{UPPER_SNAKE}` tokens (e.g. between `<!-- runtime-placeholders:start -->` / `:end -->`), built by scanning every shipped governance doc. Governance docs that are fill-in templates (agent-approved-paths.md, naming-conventions.md, and any other doc whose tokens are hand-fill slots) change frontmatter to `status: template` — frontmatter only. First grep src/ and test/ for anything that reads governance frontmatter `status` and keep it working.
acceptanceCriteria: every token in shipped status: active governance docs is either in the list or its doc is status: template
tests reading governance status still pass
userStories.testEvidence: test/up02-d-runtime-placeholders.test.ts 6/6 (list covers every raw token in active+draft governance docs; templates re-statused); registry+doctor tests 283/283; parity/citations/adr-references pass

userStories.title: Placeholder scanner module (ARC-051)
userStories.description: New src/modules/placeholders.ts: parse a markdown doc's frontmatter status; find `{UPPER_SNAKE}` tokens outside fenced code blocks and inline code; read the runtime-token list from the installed spell-authoring-standards.md; return unknown tokens per doc. If spell-authoring-standards.md is not installed, report the check as skipped (not failed).
acceptanceCriteria: unit tests: fenced/inline tokens ignored; template docs skipped; list parsed; missing standards doc -> skipped
scanning src/assets/.arcane/governance yields zero unknown tokens (fresh-install AC)
userStories.testEvidence: test/up02-d-placeholders-module.test.ts 18/18 (fenced/inline/${} ignored; template+draft skipped; list parsed; missing standard or list -> skipped; real src/assets and root .arcane/governance scan -> zero unknown tokens)

userStories.title: `spell doctor` placeholder warning + block-push remedy (ARC-051 decision 4, ARC-049 decision 3)
userStories.description: Register a doctor check that scans the installed .arcane/governance/*.md and reports each unknown token (file + token) as a non-blocking warning — exit code unchanged. In checkPushPolicy's 'declared but not enforced' finding, name `spell block-push` as the remedy (the command is added by lane A; reference by name only).
acceptanceCriteria: doctor test: unknown token in active doc -> warn, exit unchanged; template doc -> silent
doctor test: declared-but-not-enforced remedy names `spell block-push`
